component.name: KeySender
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("key", port) pending = [] busy = invalid while true msg = wait(0, port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then pending.Push(msg.getData()) else if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" then busy = invalid end if if busy = invalid and pending.Count() > 0 then busy = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") busy.SetMessagePort(port) busy.SetUrl(m.top.server + "/api/key?name=" + pending.Shift()) if not busy.AsyncGetToString() then busy = invalid end if end while end sub
